evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'I'll just ask you a few questions and confirm the details and then I'll be able to provide you an accurate estimate and this will just take about ten minutes. Sounds good.' — framing present but no clear wait for confirmation before launching into questions.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep jumps directly into confirming existing details from the prior move without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer to follow up on.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns were raised, so no reflection opportunity.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep confirms: eleventh floor two-bedroom apartment, freight elevator reserved, walking distance ~50-100 feet, destination is four-story townhome at 1606 Camet Street, 2634 sq ft (but customer notes only second and third floors occupied). Rep does not ask about property type (other than what was already stated), number of rooms beyond bedroom count, or special considerations.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep references prior move: 'we can go ahead and estimate the same time from same hours from the last time... eight and a half to nine and a half just to make sure but at the end of the day, you will only be charged for the actual hours render.' Anchors to prior experience but does not personalize to this specific move's concerns or details.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: No fee transparency (no trip fee, overnight fee, or packing materials mentioned). No 'not a guess' or 2.5-hour minimum framing. Mention of 'actual hours rendered' but no structured fee or increment transparency.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Rep moves directly to scheduling without gauging customer reaction to the estimate.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False — rep does not revisit or confirm the two promises at all.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks 'Well, yeah, so Walter, will there be anything else that I can help you with today?' — generic throwaway question, not genuine concern check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' equivalent.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep says 'Well, let's go ahead and schedule this one' but does not ask 'Would you like our help with your move?' — rep assumes consent and books without explicit ask.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: date (Friday, October 30th), time window (8:30 AM–9:00 AM), crew size (three movers), moving-from and moving-to addresses. Missing: phone number confirmation, no notes left about customer concerns (there were none raised, but standard practice is to confirm contact details).

top_strength: The rep successfully gathered and confirmed all four discovery basics (name, date, from/to route, approximate size) and leveraged prior move history to expedite estimate accuracy.
coaching_note: This call skipped Section 2 entirely — never ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' — which means no concerns to follow up on, no promises to anchor, and no closing. The estimate was never validated ('Does that feel fair?'), the two promises were never delivered, and the explicit ask for the business never happened; rep assumed consent instead. Treat this as a consultation follow-up, not a full sales call, and rebuild the discovery + concern-gathering + commitment loop.
